title: ieee80211: Conform to ieee802.11-2016 for the Capability Info field.
description:
The format and meaning of the bits in the Capability information field
has been different than what was implemented since at least 802.11-2016.

Defined in 9.4.1.4 Capability Information field.

notes.body: @alagoutte Can you have a quick look please.

commits_data.title: ieee80211: Conform to ieee802.11-2016 for the Capability Info field.
commits_data.message:
ieee80211: Conform to ieee802.11-2016 for the Capability Info field.

The format and meaning of the bits in the Capability information field
has been different than what was implemented since at least 802.11-2016.

Defined in 9.4.1.4 Capability Information field.
